status: Read-only implementation trace; no actual KerML operand execution claim
observations: InvocationExpressionAdapter documents operand as an Xtext parsing workaround outside normative abstract syntax; it returns OperandEList.
OperandEList.addUnique calls TypeUtil.addOwnedParameterTo and sets PRIVATE visibility. Its read methods expose an empty list; callers use argument for readback.
TypeUtil.addOwnedParameterTo creates a ParameterMembership via addBoundFeatureTo, creates a Feature with FeatureValue for the operand, attaches membership to ownedRelationship and sets IN direction.

shared_intersect_boundary.existing: ComputedSettings applies language-owned SettingValues plans atomically, checks revision/type/budget and derives readback.
shared_intersect_boundary.gap: SettingEdit currently supports Set and Unset only. Actual adapter needs owned object construction and operand insertion semantics; do not erase feature flags or store a fake derived operand list.

qualification: Pinned Pilot behavior is comparative evidence. Normative semantic qualification and independent execution observations remain open.
